# JLCPCB Fabrication and Assembly

Curated by Skill Harbor: the fabrication skill for JLCPCB, the Shenzhen-based PCB fabrication and assembly service and sister company of LCSC, sharing the same parts library. It covers the two typical uses separately: bare prototype PCBs plus a framed stencil during prototyping, with parts sourced separately and hand-assembled in the lab, and fully assembled boards for production runs, using LCSC parts. It documents the assembly parts library, basic versus extended parts, the BOM and component placement formats required for assembly, assembly constraints and rotation offsets, the JLCPCB design rules and capabilities, and the ordering workflow step by step. For Gerber and placement export, stencil ordering and BOM management it points back to the bom skill in this batch rather than duplicating it. By @aklofas, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: this skill is a single SKILL.md with no references or scripts folder, so the install is just that file; the official JLCPCB API requires approval, so API ordering is not available to everyone by default; and fabrication and assembly cost real money, so review every order, quantities and files, before paying. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
